verdict.rationale: Cline offers its own programmatic surfaces: a headless CLI for scripting and CI/CD, an ACP mode that any ACP-capable client can drive, and an SDK built on the same core engine as the CLI, Kanban, VS Code extension and JetBrains plugin. That shared engine suggests broad programmatic reach, but nothing documents full parity with the UI, and no OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: documented API/UI feature-parity statement, published API reference or OpenAPI spec, programmatic coverage of UI-specific features such as diff review, checkpoints and Kanban card actions, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Build AI agents and integrations powered by the same core engine behind the CLI, Kanban, VS Code extension, and JetBrains plugin.
Run Cline in your terminal with interactive chat or fully headless automation for CI/CD and scripting.
Any ACP-capable client can use Cline as its coding agent without a dedicated extension — the same agent you use in the terminal, embedded in the tool you're already working in.
Use headless mode for scripts/automation and processable output.
